agreements.Kate: For the upcoming round, each fisher shall target a harvest of no more than 6 tons. 1. Individual cap: - No fisher may intentionally attempt to harvest more than 6 tons in the month. 2. Soft fairness rule: - If the lake begins the month below 20 tons, each fisher should reduce their target to 4 tons or less. - If the lake begins the month at 20 tons or more, the 6-ton cap applies. 3. Mutual obligation: - Each fisher agrees to announce their intended target before fishing begins. - Each fisher agrees not to exceed their announced target by more than 1 ton. 4. Overharvest response: - If any fisher exceeds their announced target by more than 1 ton, the others are released from the cap next month and may renegotiate from scratch. 5. Conservation commitment: - If the lake falls below 10 tons at the start of a month, all fishers shall immediately reduce their target to 2 tons until the lake recovers to at least 20 tons. This rule set is intended to keep the lake above the collapse threshold while still allowing each fisher a meaningful share.

result.nl_contract: 1. For the next month, each fisher commits to a harvest cap of 0.5 tons. 2. If the lake is below 10 tons at the start of the month, each fisher’s cap becomes 0 tons for that month. 3. If the lake is at or above 20 tons at the start of a future month, the group may vote to raise the cap to 1 ton per fisher for that month only. 4. No fisher may intentionally exceed their cap. If someone does, the others commit to reduce their own cap by 0.25 tons next month unless the breach is unanimously acknowledged as accidental and corrected. 5. After each month, everyone reports actual catches honestly. 6. If the lake ever starts a month below 5 tons, all fishers commit to 0 tons until the lake recovers above 10 tons. 7. Our shared objective is to keep the lake above collapse risk and rebuild stock so that future months can support higher catches.

agreements.Emma: For the upcoming round, we adopt the following harvest constitution: 1. Harvest cap: - Each fisher may catch at most 2 tons this month. - If the lake stock at the start of the month is below 15 tons, each fisher may catch at most 1 ton. 2. Minimum restraint: - If the lake stock at the start of the month is 10 tons or less, each fisher agrees to catch no more than 1 ton. - If the lake stock at the start of the month is below 5 tons, all fishers must catch 0 tons to avoid collapse. 3. Fairness rule: - No fisher should exceed another fisher’s catch by more than 1 ton in the same month unless the lake stock is above 50 tons. 4. Mutual obligation: - We commit to prioritize lake recovery over short-term gain. - If any fisher observes the lake falling below 8 tons, all fishers will immediately reduce their next-month target by 1 ton. 5. Enforcement norm: - Any fisher who voluntarily exceeds the agreed cap should publicly acknowledge it in the discussion and commit to a compensating reduction of 1 ton in the next month. This rule is intended to keep the lake safely above the collapse threshold while allowing modest, fair harvests and preserving long-run income.
